text:
Ben (partnerships): hey legal + eng — need to get localized EULA + marketplace attachment bundles ready for EU/JP/AU listings. who can own translations vs legal signoff?
Carla (legal): we can produce localized EULAs but need final product copy and SKU -> region mapping first. also need to confirm data residency clauses for EU/JP.
Ben (partnerships): noted. i have the SKU mapping draft here: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/sku-mapping-2026 (private). will ping the doc to the thread.
Devon (ops): we can host localized PDFs on S3 and wire up signed URLs for marketplace artifacts. i need filenames, SHA256 hashes, and target buckets per region. recommend TTL 7d for staging links.
Emily (eng): fyi, embedding region toggle flags in the listing manifest will reduce mismatches. instead of separate PDFs per minor wording change, include a "jurisdiction_overrides" section. example snippet:
```json
{
  "product_id": "rw-inference-core",
  "version": "v1.2.0",
  "attachments": [
    {"name": "eula.pdf", "region": "default", "s3_key": "eulas/default/rw-eula-v1.2.pdf", "sha256": "<hash>"},
    {"name": "eula.pdf", "region": "eu", "s3_key": "eulas/eu/rw-eula-eu-v1.2.pdf", "sha256": "<hash>"}
  ],
  "jurisdiction_overrides": {"EU": {"data_residency_clause": "eu-residency-required"}}
}
```
Carla (legal): that approach works. legal signoff required for each jurisdiction override. also need localized company contact address + privacy link.
Ben (partnerships): timeline suggestion: translations + localized address by Fri 1 week, legal review complete by Wed next week, ops uploads by Thu next week, staging marketplace drafts to be created Fri next week. Is that feasible?
Emily (eng): can do manifest changes this week; i'll open a PR and tag @Carla for review. will add a validation step that fails CI if an attachment referenced in manifest is missing or hash mismatch.
Devon (ops): ops can script the upload and generate SHA256s. will need a service account with write access to staging buckets; @Ben please create.
Carla (legal): i'll start translations queue but need the product copy snapshots — Ben, please freeze copy for locales.
Ben (partnerships): locking copy by EOD tomorrow. also check marketplaces' filename requirements: AWS wants `terms.pdf` for some offers, GCP expects a URL in the listing doc, Azure has a manifest attachment list. i'll compile a quick matrix.
MarketplaceBot: [staging] Draft listing created for rw-inference-core (staging) — ID rw-2026-03-stg.
Emily (eng): quick Q — for JP, do we need Japanese notary page? Carla?
Carla (legal): JP often expects a localized consumer-facing clause; notary rarely required for B2B SaaS but will confirm with counsel.
Ben (partnerships): ok. action items: 1) Ben: publish final SKU->region CSV + copy freeze (by EOD tomorrow). 2) Carla: start legal review queue and translations kickoff (by Fri). 3) Devon: provision service account & upload script (by next Thu). 4) Emily: PR for manifest + CI validation (this week). 5) Ops+Legal: confirm marketplace filename/hash constraints per AWS/GCP/Azure (Ben to consolidate). please react with :thumbsup: if assigned and add blockers here.
Emily (eng): :thumbsup:
Devon (ops): :thumbsup:
Carla (legal): :thumbsup: starting translations.
Ben (partnerships): thanks all — i'll drop the SKU CSV and copy snapshot into the doc and follow up in the thread. if anybody has vendor contacts at marketplace teams, share here so we can preflight the listing.
MarketplaceBot: reminder: staging listings expire in 14 days unless flagged.
Ben (partnerships): noted, will prioritize staging push after uploads.
Carla (legal): FYI attaching previous EU EULA baseline for reference: /legal/templates/eu-eula-baseline-v0.9.
Emily (eng): cheers. i'll tag the PR with a link to this thread for context.
